description: A batch_not_equivalent warning on a result whose predictions equal batch 1's (batch 1, bit-identical by definition).

/warnings.message: Example document assembled from the C++ (ort_probe) measurements behind docs/feasibility.md section 7.3 (2026-11-21, three rounds, each round one trial in its own process). Per-trial count, mean, p50, p95, min, max and standard deviation, the session creation times and the QNN profile are measured values. p99_ms and the pooled aggregate percentiles were not recorded and are estimates.
Background CPU load was not sampled.
The first inference was not timed separately.
At batch size 8 this model's predictions differ from its batch-1 file's.
